hardCaps.publicInvariant: Evidence, policy, stage, decision, appeal, recall membership, and reconsideration authority remain immutable and unique.
Exact replay and unknown response recovery cannot create a second public effect.
Persisted work remains recoverable and stale lease owners cannot commit review, recall, or delivery effects.
FINAL migration preserves V1 identity, saved responses, pending work, events, and audit history.

specGaps.summary: Reconsideration list order is unpublished, so comparisons use the frozen ID set.
No Recall or Reconsideration event type is published, so no new event name is required.
